_doc: Curated comparative-oncology candidate ideas for autonomous generation. Each pairs a real, clinically-relevant agent with a REDOCK-VERIFIED target (PIK3CA or KDR — the only verified target_library entries). service.generate_candidate_ideas seeds only those whose docking inputs actually resolve (verified target + PubChem-resolvable ligand) and that don't already exist, so each becomes fresh, dockable work for the falsification loop. IMPORTANT: evidence_refs here are CURATION PLACEHOLDERS ('curate:<topic>'), not asserted citations — the generation/docking gate does NOT depend on them; an operator must attach real PMIDs before a candidate is ever promoted. Antibody agents (ramucirumab/bevacizumab) are intentionally omitted — no small-molecule SMILES to dock. Grow this file (and data/target_library.json) to widen the search space.

candidates.rationale: Pan-class-I PI3K inhibitor (p110a-active); tests whether broad PI3K blockade engages the PIK3CA pocket.
Beta-sparing PI3Ka-selective inhibitor with enhanced activity against mutant PIK3CA; a selectivity contrast to alpelisib.
Pan-PI3K inhibitor (GDC-0941); broad-class probe of the PIK3CA site.
Next-generation PI3Ka inhibitor that promotes degradation of mutant p110a; a distinct mechanism at the verified pocket.
PI3Ka-selective inhibitor; another selectivity point against the PIK3CA pocket.
Dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor; tests dual-pathway engagement at the PI3K site.
PI3K delta/gamma inhibitor; an off-isoform probe to contrast pocket engagement.
Dual pan-PI3K/mTOR inhibitor (BEZ235); broad engagement probe.
Multi-target VEGFR2 (KDR) inhibitor; anti-angiogenic engagement of the verified KDR pocket.
VEGFR2/PDGFR inhibitor with documented soft-tissue-sarcoma activity; clinically-relevant KDR hypothesis.
Potent, selective VEGFR1-3 inhibitor; high-selectivity KDR probe.
Multi-kinase VEGFR2 inhibitor; durability of KDR engagement.
VEGFR2/FGFR multi-kinase inhibitor; broad anti-angiogenic engagement probe.
VEGFR2/MET inhibitor; tests engagement alongside MET-axis activity.
Highly selective pan-VEGFR inhibitor; clean KDR-selectivity probe.
VEGFR2/EGFR/RET inhibitor; multi-axis engagement probe at KDR.
Triple angiokinase (VEGFR/FGFR/PDGFR) inhibitor; anti-angiogenic engagement probe.
VEGFR2/RAF multi-kinase inhibitor; engagement alongside RAF-axis activity.
Potent pan-VEGFR inhibitor; anti-angiogenic KDR engagement probe.
VEGFR/KIT inhibitor; engagement probe at the verified KDR pocket.
